Google/Meta/Amazon ad-spend can be a crippling The Consumer Audio market is one of the oldest consumer tech markets.

Every existing Technology and Product Segment is a quagmire; veterans have 'seen it all'.

Our products have to be compelling alternatives to what's available.

But different enough to stand out.

But not so different that partners and customers can't easily spot the value proposition. for a start up brand.  AGF and it's products need to be exciting enough to generate buzz:  Channels: An exciting brand story and profitable to sell.  Media: Newsworthy so reviewers are eager to cover them.  Customers: Are drawn in by the promise of a new brand truly doing new things - that they can't get anywhere else.
